BloodEssence.DescriptionText: [Debug] A lovely Red Marble dropped from the living, it swirls with life energy.

VerminSalve.DescriptionText: [Debug] The most delightful human dessert known to exist, all it needs is some strawberry sauce.

IrradiantGruel.DescriptionText: [Debug] A delicious human smoothie packed full of nutrients and antioxidants! Supposedly it improves the quality of blood.

ExtractBloodEssence.DescriptionText: [Debug] I know they have Red Marbles, its just about applying the apropriate force.

FedRat.DescriptionText: [Debug] How can someone turn down this extraordinary dessert, surely they will feel much better after indulging in its deliciousness.

FedIrradiantGruel.DescriptionText: [Debug] It's delicious AND good for you, come on drink it, I promise there's nothing strange in it. Does your blood feel any... cleaner?

CopperSword.DescriptionText: [Debug] A bright Orange Blade made of some alloy, surely not copper as that would be too soft. The blue handle makes the color pop.
